description: Create a new draft dataset listing on DataBazaar and return its dataset_id. Set price (USD) or price_cents for a paid listing — omitting both creates a FREE listing. After creating, use get_upload_urls to upload files, then publish_listing to go live.

auction_config.description: Required for auction or hybrid pricing

category.description: Category: geographic, pricing, sensor, images, text, financial, scientific, social, retail, other

price.description: Price in USD (e.g. 19). Mutually exclusive with price_cents.

price_cents.description: Price in integer cents (e.g. 1900 = $19.00). Mutually exclusive with price.

pricing_type.description: Pricing model. Inferred as buy_it_now when a positive price is given; defaults to free only when no price is supplied.

schema.description: Data schema describing columns/fields. Set { "format": "zip" } when uploading an archive.

name: create_listing
